links.outcome: Physician macro-AUC with versus without AI assistance in reader study
links.effect: AI-assisted macro-AUC 0.970 vs 0.905 physician-only (tertiary cohort); 0.963 vs 0.902 (county-hospital cohort)
links.quote: In the reader study, AI-assisted interpretation yielded higher observed macro-AUCs than physician-only interpretation in the tertiary cohort (0.970 vs. 0.905) and the county-hospital cohort (0.963 vs. 0.902).

links.outcome: Macro-AUC internal versus external multi-site validation
links.effect: Macro-AUC 0.942 (95% CI 0.910–0.964) internally and 0.931 (95% CI 0.898–0.956) externally; small drop at county hospitals
links.quote: The multimodal model achieved the highest observed macro-AUC, with macro-AUC of 0.942 (95% CI: 0.910–0.964) internally and 0.931 (95% CI: 0.898–0.956) externally; subtype–level AUCs were consistent across CE1–CE5, with most errors occurring between adjacent transitional stages.

unlisted_practices: lightweight model design for resource-limited settings
interpretability analyses of lesion localisation and patient-specific modality contributions

screen.reason: Evaluated diagnostic accuracy of an AI model on external validation sets and conducted a reader study comparing physician interpretation with versus without AI assistance.
